outline: Technical textile is a textile product manufactured for non-aesthetic purposes, where the function is the primary criterion, including automotive applications, medical textiles, geotextiles, agrotextiles, and protective clothing, etc.
schedule:
Week 1 - Introduction to Technical Textiles
Week 2 - Textile Reinforced Composites - 1
Week 3 - Textile Reinforced Composites - 2
Week 4 - Textile Reinforced Composites - 3
Week 5 - Filter Fabrics
Week 6 - Geotextiles
Week 7 - Protective Textiles
